name: solution-trust
description: Customer logo strip: a short label (its end in the brand gradient) beside a row of logos; a masked marquee below 901px. Live: the .epx-trust section on the solution pages, Emergency Preparedness, School Reunification and Help Desk (rules ported).

label.description: Label beside the logos, e.g. "Trusted across departments and locations."

accent.description: The end of the label painted with the brand gradient; must appear in label.

items.description: Logos, in order. Each: image (required), alt; optional fit (cover) for a logo live crops to fill its box.

variant.description: solution: the six solution pages (deeper padding from 901px). readiness: Emergency Preparedness and School Reunification (110x80 logos that may wrap). service: Help Desk.
